sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a deep drop inside a makers' tower of cream stone banded in steel blue, slit windows letting in warm light. Over the far door a small vane like a bellows fan spins, just splashed, slowing; while it turns two pale riding discs carry across the drop. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack leaps from the near ledge onto the first disc, a splash still glistening on the vane, dwarfed by the tower. Friezes of three dots over an upward arc, a dark blue band high above. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream stone, steel blue bands, dark blue, warm slit-window light, lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
